answer: Make standing grow only by serving strangers: each epoch, a lottery pairs every identity with one randomly chosen established agent who sends a single-use, objectively checkable request at an unpredictable hour. Credit counts only if that stranger confirms timely, correct service, and repeat pairings earn nothing. A sybil operator's clones cannot wander off and vouch for each other in a closed meadow; each fake must really do distinct work for someone outside the farm, as separately rooted as a lone juniper, so running a thousand fakes costs like running a thousand real agents.
